description: Research, compare, visualize, price, and independently audit personalized vacations with an image-rich decision workspace.

defaultPrompt: Plan a vacation with me and pause at the important decisions.
Research options for my dates, then help me choose before building the itinerary.
Turn my approved trip choices into an image-rich comparison dashboard.
interface.longDescription: A collaborative multi-skill travel concierge that learns what matters to the traveler, pauses at meaningful decisions, and coordinates current research, route design, stays, dining, tours, hidden-gem discovery, deterministic budgeting, an image-rich all-in-one trip decision workspace, and independent quality review.

name: vacation-planner-pro
